resources.string: Monitors Volume Down long-press and 3-finger swipe gestures to capture the screen silently, open the cropping overlay, and share selections seamlessly.
Long-press Volume Down (700ms) or swipe down with 3 fingers (> 300px) anywhere to capture without system dialogs, crop with precision cyan guides, and share immediately.
Follow these steps to activate silent key capture and cropping overlays.
Required to detect the Volume Down long-press and capture screen content silently without MediaProjection prompts.
Prevents Android from killing the background service when the phone is idle.
Hold the Volume Down button for 700ms anywhere on your device. The volume indicator is suppressed, and the transparent cropping canvas appears.
A white translucent bar docked at the top-left screen edge. Tap to capture instantly or drag to reposition. 100% of touches outside the bar pass directly to underlying apps without blocking.
Drag across the screen to select a region to crop
Drag anywhere to draw crop box
Drag handles to resize • Inside to move • Outside to reselect
Choose your trigger method. Volume Down long-press is recommended for zero on-screen elements, or use the white translucent edge bar.
Default. Suppresses volume dialog. Zero on-screen overlay; 100% untouched OS screen touches, typing, and gaming.
White translucent bar docked at top-left edge (FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL). Tap or drag to capture. Zero touches blocked across the rest of the display.
Enable both Volume Down long-press and the top-left white translucent edge bar simultaneously.
Rapidly triple-press Volume Up anytime to immediately remove the touch overlay and unblock the screen.
